svg.title: Air frame format
svg.text: A packed binary record, never JSON. JSON exists only on the USART3 link to the PC.
The type byte carries the MIC flag
Why the flag is not just the length
14 bytes is BOTH an unauthenticated data frame and an
authenticated status frame. Length alone cannot tell them apart,
so the flag lives in the type byte instead.
Any decoder must mask with & 0x7F before comparing the type, or
every signed frame reads as an unknown type.
Gateway/Core/Src/node_table.c pulls out the node id and sequence
